name: Easy Pressure Cooker Greek Chicken with Orzo Pasta, Cucumber-Tomato Salad & Feta

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels and cut into bite-sized pieces. Drain olives. Place both in a medium bowl, along with lemon juice and Greek seasoning, then stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
907 g chicken thighs, boneless skinless
½ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
2 tbsp lemon juice
2 tbsp Greek seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Place orzo, broth, garlic, additional Greek seasoning, and salt in a 6-quart pressure cooker insert; stir to combine. Add chicken mixture (do not stir), then lock lid and set to pressure cook on HIGH for 5 minutes. Once done, drape a clean towel over the vent, then manually release the pressure.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g orzo pasta
3 cups chicken or vegetable broth
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp Greek seasoning
¾ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 pint grape tomatoes
1 English cucumber
½ small bunch fresh dill

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, halve grape tomatoes. Trim and quarter cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place all three in a medium bowl, along with feta and vinaigrette. Stir to combine the salad and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 (113 g) pkg crumbled feta cheese
¼ cup balsamic vinaigrette

instructions.primary_message: When the pressure has been released, stir to combine the orzo and chicken. Set aside to thicken, 5 minutes.
To serve, divide orzo and chicken between plates or bowls. Top with salad and enjoy!
